reviews.title: Best budget, great quality microphone!
reviews.comment: Just had this delivered and unboxed today. Was super reluctant to purchase this due to these kinds of products always having mixed recent reviews, but after plugging it into my PC and fiddling with the microphone gain, the fact that this microphone sounds like a near studio quality microphone is insane. I had previously purchased a Shure SM7B and all its necessary peripheral parts and that costed me a total of $900+, everything new. I spent $50 on this microphone. $50. And it’s a plug and play!! I was recommended this microphone by my friend and others, and I am glad I decided to finally order one. USB-C cord length provided is more than enough, comes with a headset volume knob, microphone gain knob, tap to mute button, and a button to tap to change the RGB lighting on the microphone. Screwing on the stand was a piece of cake. This is an unpaid and unbiased review of someone who has tried multiple microphones. If you’re looking for a budget, easy to connect and use, great quality microphone, this is the one for you!

reviews.author: TR

reviews.title: Best choice for beginners
reviews.comment: I’ve been using this FIFINE microphone for voice recording, podcasting, and casual content creation, and overall I’m really impressed with what you get for the price. Setup was extremely easy, it’s just a plug-and-play, so I just connected it via USB and it worked immediately without needing extra drivers or software. I later was able to get xlr cables and an audio mixer and it is 10x better. The difference between the sound quality of this mic and the podmic is not a noticable difference to audiences who don’t know the difference. The sound quality is clear and clean, although when the mic is not positioned directly in front of you, the sound is not picked up as well. Voices come through naturally, and it’s a noticeable upgrade from a headset or built-in laptop microphone. For streaming, Discord, or podcasting, it performs very well considering it’s an entry-level condenser mic. The main downside is that it can pick up background noise if your room isn’t treated or if your keyboard and mouse are nearby. This isn’t unusual for condenser microphones, but it’s something to be aware of. A boom arm or pop filter helps improve results quite a bit. Build quality feels solid for the price, though it’s clearly not meant to compete with higher-end studio microphones. I did end up dropping it a few times on accident but I must say that the durability is exellent and dropping it will not effect the sound quality. The mic is of reasonable size and extremely lightweight and paired with the fifine boom arm, the ability to adjust the position is endless. Overall, this is an excellent choice for beginners or anyone wanting good audio quality without spending a lot.

reviews.title: Sharp Looking , Easy to Use & Works Well
reviews.comment: So far this has performed well.  It is a little large, but is what I expected and totally fine.  Totally plug n play, no, software and no setup needed, just plug it in and start using it.  The style was the final selling point for my choosing this item and for me it looks nice on my desk.  I would purchase this item again.

reviews.title: Decent microphone for the money.
reviews.comment: Not a bad mic. It has held up well to carrying it around in a backpack. I like the dual input although I only use the USB. It’s very plug and play. I haven’t had any issues operating it. 4 stars because it’s not the best sounding microphone. Seem to me it doesn’t have a real warm or rich sound, it lacks the bass for that. Great for the price and is easy to turn the gain up and down and mute it. If you’re looking for a budget friendly mic it’s good enough.
reviews.author: Kell Richardson
